_note: Test-only scenario conventions. Production code must never read fixtures/scenarios.

references.${sN.<path>}: Value from step sN's captured result (request, run, proposal = latest proposal for the run, action, latest_action, work_item, decision, events, latest_run).
references.${knowledge_revision}: Current workspace knowledge revision (e.g. from the latest Run/Proposal based_on_revision or an ImportPreviewResult).

step_actions.await_run: Poll GET /runs/{run_id} until status in until_status_in; captures run, latest proposal, latest action
step_actions.commit_proposal: POST /proposals/{id}/commit with ProposalCommit and the given Idempotency-Key; captures action or error
step_actions.commit_proposal_if_awaiting_review: As commit_proposal, skipped when the proposal was auto-committed

step_fields.workspace_id: Optional override of the scenario workspace for this step

assertions: Each expectation is {assert, step, ...}. Text assertions (text_matches/text_not_matches) inspect only the named fields that exist; when_kind limits a payload assertion to proposals of that kind; optional=true records but does not fail. work_item_count_delta compares GET /work-items count against the post-seed baseline.

assertion_fields.source_body_unchanged.strip_front_matter: When true, compare SourceRecord.body with content_from minus its leading YAML front matter (--- ... ---) and following blank lines (PROTOCOL #36).

runner.command: uv run --no-project --with httpx==0.28.1 --with jsonschema==4.25.1 python scripts/run_scenarios.py --manage --port 8020 [--secondary-port 8021] [--only t04,t12] [--holdouts] [--json out.json]
runner.stacks: --manage starts private stacks via scripts/stack.sh: the shared stack on --port; each fresh_seed / 'server env K=V' scenario and the holdout set get a fresh stack on --secondary-port (default --port+1), one at a time. Use distinct port pairs (e.g. 8040/8041) and graph prefixes (--prefix) when several runners share the host. --base-url runs everything against one existing stack instead.
